command: set -euo pipefail; echo CPU_ONLINE=$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN); awk '{print "LOAD1="$1,"LOAD5="$2,"LOAD15="$3}' /proc/loadavg; awk '/MemAvailable:/{print "MEM_AVAILABLE_KB="$2}' /proc/meminfo; echo PROD_CHROME_COUNT=$(pgrep -a -f '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' | grep -v -- '--type=' | grep -v 'bash -lc' | wc -l); echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); echo CPU_CAPACITY_PASS
